segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome back to EnglishPod.

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: And my name is Catherine and today we have an upper intermediate level lesson all about money.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们有一个关于金钱的高中级课程。

segments.en: That's right.

segments.en: We are going to be talking about money but most importantly we need to start saving money.
segments.zh: 我们将谈论金钱，但最重要的是我们需要开始存钱。

segments.en: We need to spend less.
segments.zh: 我们需要少花钱。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So, in order to control spending today we're talking about budgeting.
segments.zh: 所以，为了控制今天的支出，我们谈论的是预算。

segments.en: So let's take a look at this very important word in today's vocabulary preview.
segments.zh: 所以让我们来看看今天词汇预览中这个非常重要的词。

segments.en: Alright, so as you mentioned, budgeting is, what is to budget?
segments.zh: 好吧，正如你提到的，预算是，预算是什么？

segments.en: To budget, that's the verb.
segments.zh: 预算，这是动词。

segments.en: So budgeting is deciding how to spend your money, okay?
segments.zh: 所以预算是决定如何花钱，好吗？

segments.en: So that means that we prepare a plan for how to spend money.
segments.zh: 所以这意味着我们准备了一个如何花钱的计划。

segments.en: Alright, so that can be a noun and a verb.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以这可以是名词和动词。

segments.en: A budget is the plan on how you're going to spend money and to budget is to execute this plan.
segments.zh: 预算是关于如何花钱和预算的计划是执行这个计划。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So, today we're budgeting a family's spending.
segments.zh: 所以，今天我们正在预算一个家庭的支出。

segments.en: We're trying to control how much this family will spend in the future.

segments.en: Alright, very good.

segments.en: So why don't we listen to this dialogue for the first time.
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不第一次听这个对话。

segments.zh: 欢迎卡恩威尔先生和夫人。

segments.en: Please take a seat.

segments.en: Thank you.

segments.en: So, I understand that your family spending has skyrocketed and you want to start budgeting.
segments.zh: 我了解到，你们家的开销大幅增加，所以想开始做收支预算。

segments.en: Yes, that's correct.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: Frankly speaking, our household income is relatively high and we have never had any money problems, but I think this is the main reason as to why our spending has gone out of control.
segments.zh: 坦率地说，我们的家庭收入相对较高，我们从未遇到过任何金钱问题，但我认为这是我们支出失控的主要原因。

segments.en: We have two kids and with allowances paying their credit cards, ours, and not to mention our mortgage and car payments.
segments.zh: 我们有两个孩子，要给他们零花钱，还要还他们和我们自己的信用卡账单，更不用说房贷和车贷了。

segments.en: With the recent economic downturn, my husband's business has suffered and now we need some advice as how we can prepare a family budget.
segments.zh: 随着最近的经济下滑，我丈夫的生意受到了影响，现在我们需要一些关于如何准备家庭预算的建议。

segments.en: I see.
segments.zh: 我明白了。

segments.en: Well, you have come to the right place.
segments.zh: 好吧，你来对地方了。

segments.en: First, what we need to do is determine your cash flow.
segments.zh: 首先，我们需要做的是确定您的现金流。

segments.en: Knowing how much money is coming in will help us allocate spending to different categories such as mortgage, education, groceries, etc.
segments.zh: 知道有多少钱可以帮助我们将支出分配到抵押贷款、教育、杂货等不同类别。

segments.en: Yes, that makes sense.
segments.zh: 是的，这是有道理的。

segments.en: Secondly, I need you to bring all of your receipts for the last two to three months.
segments.zh: 其次，我需要你把过去两到三个月的所有收据都带上。

segments.en: That way we can determine what your average expenditures are and see which category you are spending money on the most.
segments.zh: 这样我们就可以确定您的平均支出是多少，并查看您最多花钱的类别。

segments.en: Usually, your fixed costs are higher and we can't do much about that, but we can usually trim your variable costs such as entertainment or clothing.
segments.zh: 通常，您的固定成本更高，我们对此无能为力，但我们通常可以削减您的可变成本，例如娱乐或服装。

segments.en: Great!
segments.zh: 太棒了！

segments.en: We will do that then.
segments.zh: 那我们会这样做。

segments.en: Now how about we treat you to a nice dinner?
segments.zh: 现在我们请您吃一顿丰盛的晚餐怎么样？

segments.en: That's another thing.
segments.zh: 那是另一回事。

segments.en: If you really want to stop spending so much money, throw away at least half of your credit cards.
segments.zh: 如果你真的想停止花这么多钱，就把至少一半的信用卡扔掉。

segments.en: Alright, we're back.

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So, let's listen to our dialogue for the last time.
segments.zh: 所以，让我们最后一次听我们的对话。

segments.en: Welcome Mr. and Mrs. Carnwell.
segments.zh: 欢迎卡恩威尔先生和夫人。

segments.en: Please take a seat.
segments.zh: 请坐。

segments.en: Thank you.
segments.zh: 谢谢。

segments.en: So, I understand that your family spending has skyrocketed and you want to start budgeting.
segments.zh: 我了解到，你们家的开销大幅增加，所以想开始做收支预算。

segments.en: Yes, that's correct.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: Frankly speaking, our household income is relatively high and we have never had any money problems.
segments.zh: 坦率地说，我们的家庭收入相对较高，我们从未遇到过任何金钱问题。

segments.en: But I think this is the main reason as to why our spending has gone out of control.
segments.zh: 但我认为这是我们支出失控的主要原因。

segments.en: We have two kids and with allowances, paying their credit cards, ours, and not to mention our mortgage and car payments.
segments.zh: 我们有两个孩子和津贴，支付他们的信用卡，我们的，更不用说我们的抵押贷款和汽车付款。

segments.en: With the recent economic downturn, my husband's business has suffered and now we need some advice as how we can prepare a family budget.
segments.zh: 随着最近的经济下滑，我丈夫的生意受到了影响，现在我们需要一些关于如何准备家庭预算的建议。

segments.en: I see.
segments.zh: 我明白了。

segments.en: Well, you have come to the right place.
segments.zh: 好吧，你来对地方了。

segments.en: First, what we need to do is determine your cash flow.
segments.zh: 首先，我们需要做的是确定您的现金流。

segments.en: Knowing how much money is coming in will help us allocate spending to different categories such as mortgage, education, groceries, etc.
segments.zh: 知道有多少钱可以帮助我们将支出分配到抵押贷款、教育、杂货等不同类别。

segments.en: Yes, that makes sense.
segments.zh: 是的，这是有道理的。

segments.en: Secondly, I need you to bring all of your receipts for the last two to three months.
segments.zh: 其次，我需要你把过去两到三个月的所有收据都带上。

segments.en: That way we can determine what your average expenditures are and see which category you are spending money on the most.
segments.zh: 这样我们就可以确定您的平均支出是多少，并查看您最多花钱的类别。

segments.en: Usually, your fixed costs are higher and we can't do much about that.
segments.zh: 通常，您的固定成本更高，我们对此无能为力。

segments.en: But we can usually trim your variable costs such as entertainment or clothing.
segments.zh: 但我们通常可以削减您的可变成本，例如娱乐或服装。

segments.en: Great!
segments.zh: 太棒了！

segments.en: We will do that then.
segments.zh: 那我们会这样做。

segments.en: Now how about we treat you to a nice dinner?
segments.zh: 现在我们请您吃一顿丰盛的晚餐怎么样？

segments.en: That's another thing.
segments.zh: 那是另一回事。

segments.en: If you really want to stop spending so much money, throw away at least half of your credit cards.
segments.zh: 如果你真的想停止花这么多钱，就把至少一半的信用卡扔掉。

segments.en: Alright we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So now talking about allowances, you said you had an allowance when you were a kid.
segments.zh: 所以现在说到津贴，你说你小时候有津贴。

segments.en: Did you really have a $10 a week allowance?
segments.zh: 你真的有每周 10 美元的津贴吗？

segments.en: No, I think it was like $8.
segments.zh: 不，我想它就像 8 美元。

segments.en: It started out at $6 or $5 a week and then I think the most I got was like $10 or $11.
segments.zh: 它的起价为每周 6 美元或 5 美元，然后我认为我得到的最多的是 10 美元或 11 美元。

segments.en: So it was like almost about a dollar a day.
segments.zh: 所以它几乎就像每天大约一美元。

segments.en: About that.
segments.zh: 关于那件事。

segments.en: But usually the point was that, well, I started working when I was 15 because my parents thought it was important for children to learn how money works.
segments.zh: 但通常重点是，嗯，我 15 岁时开始工作，因为我的父母认为孩子们了解金钱的运作方式很重要。

segments.en: But I was given that money because at the time it was enough money to go out one night.
segments.zh: 但我得到了这笔钱，因为当时足够的钱可以出去一晚。

segments.en: So on Friday nights if I wanted to go out with my friends, I could go out to watch a movie and get a slice of pizza and $10 was enough.
segments.zh: 所以在周五晚上，如果我想和朋友出去玩，我可以出去看电影，买一片披萨，10 美元就足够了。

segments.en: Now $10 doesn't even buy you a ticket to the movie.
segments.zh: 现在 10 美元甚至没有给你买电影票。

segments.en: But at the time it was more than enough.
segments.zh: 但在当时已经绰绰有余了。

segments.en: So this is important I guess because different families have different ways of upbringing their children and in many cases this doesn't happen.
segments.zh: 所以这很重要，因为不同的家庭有不同的抚养孩子的方式，在许多情况下不会发生这种情况。

segments.en: If I want to go out to the movies on a Saturday, then my parents will give me $30.
segments.zh: 如果我想在星期六去看电影，那么我的父母会给我 30 美元。

segments.en: And if I want to go out next weekend, they'll also give me money.
segments.zh: 如果我想下周末出去，他们也会给我钱。

segments.en: So it's interesting to see the contrast because obviously when I was a kid also I didn't really get this opportunity of going out all the time.
segments.zh: 所以看到对比很有趣，因为很明显，当我还是个孩子的时候，我也没有真正得到这个一直外出的机会。

segments.en: And actually I had to work for it.
segments.zh: 实际上，我必须为它工作。

segments.en: So if I wanted to go out on the weekend, I would get an allowance but also I would have to wash the car, that was typical with my dad.
segments.zh: 因此，如果我想在周末出去，我会得到津贴，但我也必须洗车，这对我爸爸来说是典型的。

segments.en: I had to wash the car.
segments.zh: 我不得不洗车。

segments.en: Well, I think it's interesting because it shows that the parents want to teach their children about budgeting.
segments.zh: 嗯，我认为这很有趣，因为它表明父母想教他们的孩子预算。

segments.en: Because if you only have $10, you really have to budget.
segments.zh: 因为如果你只有 10 美元，你真的必须预算。

segments.en: You have to decide how you will allocate that money even though it's not very much.
segments.zh: 你必须决定如何分配这笔钱，即使它不是很多。

segments.en: So in some ways it's good practice.
segments.zh: 所以在某些方面这是一个很好的做法。

segments.en: Yeah, it is.
segments.zh: 对，确实是。

segments.en: I think it's done us well.
segments.zh: 我认为这对我们做得很好。

segments.en: We're not in debt.
segments.zh: 我们没有债务。

segments.en: Not yet.
segments.zh: 还没有。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So let us know how allowances work in your country or maybe did you have an allowance when you were a kid?
segments.zh: 因此，让我们知道您所在国家/地区的津贴如何运作，或者您小时候是否有过津贴？

segments.en: A lot of people didn't have an allowance.
segments.zh: 很多人没有津贴。

segments.en: I know a lot of friends didn't get allowances.
segments.zh: 我知道很多朋友没有拿到津贴。

segments.en: So come to our website EnglishPod.com and if you have any other questions or doubts, please leave them there as well.
segments.zh: 因此，请访问我们的网站 englishpod.com，如果您有任何其他问题或疑问，请将它们也留在那里。

segments.en: We hope to hear from you.
segments.zh: 我们希望收到您的来信。

segments.en: Until next time.
segments.zh: 下次再见。
